name: CI

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      matrix:
        build_type: [Debug, Release]
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          sudo apt-get update
          sudo apt-get install -y \
            libgoogle-glog-dev \
            libgflags-dev \
            clang-tidy \
            cppcheck \
            clang-format

      - name: Install CMake
        uses: lukka/get-cmake@v3

      - name: Configure CMake
        run: |
          cmake -S . -B build \
            -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=${{ matrix.build_type }} \
            -DCMAKE_CXX_STANDARD=17 \
            -DCMAKE_CXX_STANDARD_REQUIRED=ON

      - name: Build
        run: cmake --build build --config ${{ matrix.build_type }} -- -j$(nproc)

      - name: Run tests
        run: ctest --test-dir build --output-on-failure

      - name: Run clang-tidy
        run: |
          find . -type f \( -name '*.cpp' -o -name '*.cxx' -o -name '*.cc' \) | \
          xargs -r clang-tidy -p=build --quiet

      - name: Run cppcheck
        run: |
          cppcheck --enable=all --inconclusive --std=c++17 --quiet $(git ls-files '*.cpp' '*.cxx' '*.cc')

      - name: Check code formatting
        run: |
          git ls-files '*.cpp' '*.cxx' '*.cc' '*.h' '*.hpp' | xargs -r clang-format -n

  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      matrix:
        build_type: [Debug, Release]
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          sudo apt-get update
          sudo apt-get install -y \
            libgoogle-glog-dev \
            libgflags-dev \
            clang-tidy \
            cppcheck \
            clang-format

      - name: Install CMake
        uses: lukka/get-cmake@v3

      - name: Configure CMake
        run: |
          cmake -S . -B build \
            -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=${{ matrix.build_type }} \
            -DCMAKE_CXX_STANDARD=17 \
            -DCMAKE_CXX_STANDARD_REQUIRED=ON

      - name: Build
        run: cmake --build build --config ${{ matrix.build_type }} -- -j$(nproc)

      - name: Run tests
        run: ctest --test-dir build --output-on-failure

      - name: Run clang-tidy
        run: |
          find . -type f \( -name '*.cpp' -o -name '*.cxx' -o -name '*.cc' \) | \
          xargs -r clang-tidy -p=build --quiet

      - name: Run cppcheck
        run: |
          cppcheck --enable=all --inconclusive --std=c++17 --quiet $(git ls-files '*.cpp' '*.cxx' '*.cc')

      - name: Check code formatting
